About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We’re looking for our a Berlin-based Enterprise Account Executive to bring Watershed to more companies in DACH. We’re at an inflection point: every large company is launching a sustainability program as pressure for action builds every day. You’ll do whatever it takes to get those companies on Watershed and help them be effective. As a member of our Berlin-based go-to-market organisation, you’ll help build the sales playbook, shape Watershed’s product and help us build a stellar team.

You will:

  • Sell Watershed. Find your way to the right people at leading DACH companies, educate them about effective climate programs, and help them succeed with Watershed. You’ll own the full lifecycle, from first outbound to contract signature.

  • Develop the Watershed sales playbook for winning lighthouse logos —what’s the best messaging? How do we triangulate through the org? What tools do we need?—into a repeatable machine.

  • Take Watershed into new market segments.

  • Shape Watershed’s product strategy by sharing feedback from customers on the front line.

  • Become an expert in climate, and educate companies on how they should navigate the world of carbon reduction targets, clean energy, and decarbonising their supply chain.

  • Help build the sales team.

You might be a fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of relevant account executive quota carrying experience in a SaaS organization

  • A track record of sales excellence, especially with enterprise customers (1,000-10,000 employees) at an executive level. 

  • Have experience prospecting new business in a new territory, specifically, DACH.

  • You love to build things —new playbooks for navigating organizations and ways to tell the Watershed story.

  • Are an excellent consultative seller. You listen deeply to customers and excel by helping them solve their problems.

  • Love going deep on new domains. You’ve sold products in complex or technical fields, and relish becoming an expert on your subject matter. You’re voraciously curious. You’re excited to learn everything about climate and help companies navigate this space.

  • Have a track record of doing whatever it takes to get things done. You’ve accomplished things that others thought were impossible. You’re relentlessly resourceful.

  • Want to join a startup, take responsibility for the fate of the company, and move fast.

  • Are an exceptional communicator.

  • Native German speaker, bilingual in English.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We are looking for a hands-on, tech-forward Senior Accountant to own key pillars of our Corporate General Ledger, month-end financial close, and financial reporting engine.

This is a US GAAP-based role supporting our global, consolidated reporting; knowledge of Mexican statutory/monthly reporting requirements or UK GAAP is a plus, not a requirement.

In this role, you will take ownership of critical areas of our balance sheet and P&L. Beyond standard corporate accounting, you will own the complex accounting for our carbon credits offerings to ensure audit-ready accuracy and tracking.

This is a build-and-scale role for someone who thrives in complexity and cares deeply about accuracy. You will partner cross-functionally with FP&A, Sales, Accounting Systems, and Payroll to turn evolving business needs into scalable, audit-ready accounting frameworks.

We are heavily focused on close acceleration and modernizing our accounting operations. You will partner with our team to help evaluate, test, and implement AI tools, data automation, and modern workflows to transition manual close mechanics into automated subledgers while maintaining an audit-ready standard.

What You’ll Do

Core GL Close, Financial Reporting & Flux Analysis

  • Own the GL close for core balance sheet accounts, including Cash, Prepaids, Fixed Assets, Leases, Accruals, Payroll Liabilities, and short/long-term account classifications.

  • Record monthly Stock-based Compensation (“SBC”) journal entries, track early exercise activity, and reconcile equity-related balance sheet accounts.

  • Assist in building monthly US GAAP Financial Statements while maintaining period-end cutoff discipline.

  • Perform monthly flux analysis to explain business drivers, spot trends or anomalies, and ensure financial accuracy.

  • Identify close bottlenecks and implement process improvements that reduce cycle time without sacrificing precision or control quality.

Carbon Credits and Treasury

  • Own the end-to-end accounting for our carbon credit offerings, adjustments, and monthly reconciliations.

  • Manage cash reconciliations and accounting for marketable securities, interest income, and investment gains/losses.

Global Intercompany, Tax & Statutory Compliance

  • Support and maintain the group-level intercompany framework, including elimination logic and transaction-flow documentation.

  • Support sales tax and VAT filings and compliance across various domestic and international jurisdictions in partnership with tax advisors.

  • Serve as a key point of contact for your owned accounts, preparing audit schedules and supporting workpapers.

Process Building, Systems & AI Automation

  • Document and standardize workflows for owned accounts.

  • Help build, test, and deploy AI tooling, data automation, and modern workflows to streamline rules-based tasks, accelerate reconciliations, and improve exception management.

  • Partnering with finance systems leads to contributing accounting requirements for ERP upgrades, subledger configurations, and tool integrations.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience spanning Big 4 or national public accounting and high-growth SaaS environments.

  • Strong command of US GAAP across core GL areas, including inventory, payroll, fixed assets, prepaids, leases, investments, and intercompany consolidations.

  • Hands-on experience owning a portfolio of accounts through month-end close, reconciliations, and journal entries, ideally within a multi-entity or global accounting environment.

  • Working knowledge of ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, Workday, Rillet), and advanced Excel/Google Sheets experience. Excited by the opportunity to help evaluate, test, and implement AI tools and data automation.

  • Exceptional ability to work independently, thrive in ambiguity, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to solve complex accounting questions without obvious answers and translate financial results into plain language for non-accounting stakeholders.

  • Knowledge of Mexican statutory accounting (SAT compliance) and/or UK GAAP is a plus.

  • Fluency in English is required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, plus CPA, CPC (Contador Público Certificado), or an international equivalent preferred.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We’re looking for a Corporate FP&A Manager to own our corporate financial model and serve as a primary finance partner to our Product, Customer, Business Foundation and Executive team.

Reporting to our Head of Finance, you will lead managing budget and forecast processes, variance analysis, and shaping how we measure and communicate company performance. You will work closely with our Founders, executive leadership, and key cross-functional partners to ensure financial rigor and visibility across the organization.

What You Will Do

Corporate Planning & Consolidation

  • Lead Company-Wide Planning & Forecasting: own the short and long-term corporate financial models as well as planning processes to ensure accuracy and agility in planning across revenue, headcount, expenses, and cash flow including tax forecasting and infrastructure planning

  • Lead monthly and quarterly close, board and investor reporting: budget vs. actual analysis at both corporate and departmental levels. Owning core SaaS metrics: Gross Margin %, Magic Number, Cash Burn Multiple, Rule of 40

  • Drive the cash model: to guide capital allocation

  • Translate complex financial data: into clear insights that drive operational performance and executive decision-making

Expense & Business Partnership

  • Finance partner to Product, Engineering, Design & Science on spend and resourcing decisions

  • Partner with Business Foundation and the Customer org to align resourcing with demand, watching gross margin

  • Own headcount and opex planning with department heads

What You Will Bring

  • 6-8+ years in FP&A, Strategic Finance, or Investment Banking / Venture Capital / Private Equity, including 2+ years inside a high-growth B2B SaaS company

  • Strong financial modeling, P&L management, forecasting, and annual / long-range planning experience

  • Deep understanding of SaaS metrics and recurring revenue mechanics

  • Proven business partnering: able to translate complex financials for non-finance leaders and push back when it matters

  • Nice to have: experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, and/or Rippling (or equivalent CRM/ERP/HRIS platforms)

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

To run a sustainable business, our customers need climate insights at their fingertips. That’s where great design comes in — we are building powerful software that enables the biggest companies in the world to measure their carbon footprint with ease, and drive change across their organization.

We are hiring a Product designer to join our AI Products group.

Product designers at Watershed partner closely with product and engineering from vision through execution, painting the big picture and sweating the details. About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We’re looking for a customer-focused problem solver to join our Implementation team. You’ll lead end-to-end deployments of Watershed for our largest and most complex strategic accounts - translating goals into clear plans, finding solutions to customer needs, orchestrating cross-functional work, and building customer confidence.

You’ll design scalable systems and processes for repeatability while also solving complex, bespoke needs for our largest customers. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, advisory, customer success, and external partners to keep momentum high and outcomes measurable. This is a unique opportunity to play a critical role driving the success of Watershed’s customer base.

 

You will:

  • Own and deliver implementations from kickoff to wrap-up: run discovery, map milestones, manage risks, and drive crisp execution

  • Serve as the customer’s primary point of contact during implementations, building high‑trust relationships across technical and non‑technical stakeholders

  • Design out-of-the-box, creative solutions that meet customer needs, leveraging existing product and services and generating insight into potential future needs

  • Develop a deep understanding of Watershed’s product and services to guide customers on what’s possible and make smart trade‑offs

  • Conduct enablements for customers on using complex Watershed features

  • Coordinate internal and customer teams, sequence dependencies, and renegotiate timelines when inputs change

  • Act as the voice of the customer to product and engineering, surfacing patterns, blockers, and feature requests that inform the roadmap

  • Build scalable playbooks, tooling, and processes that make implementations faster, more consistent, and measurable over time

 

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 3-6+ years in management consulting, solutions, or software implementation, preferably at a B2B SaaS company. You have experience leading customers through complex programs or projects

  • Take pride in your ability to learn new concepts quickly and thrive operating in a high-volume environment

  • Love to sweat the details, but are also able to zoom-out and see the big picture

  • Are a systems thinker who brings structure, clarity, and momentum to ambiguous problems

  • Are excellent at communicating clearly with technical and non‑technical audiences to introduce new concepts and drive alignment

  • Love working on multiple workstreams simultaneously, juggling multiple balls and keeping stakeholders accountable

  • Have a keen eye for identifying risks and drive mitigation plans to keep projects on track

  • Are an early adopter of AI solutions and excited to use them to drive impact

 

This position is required to be in person in our New York office 4 days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We're hiring a builder to architect and operate the systems, applied AI, and data infrastructure Watershed's GTM organization runs on. This is both a systems engineering role and an applied AI role - and the work is shifting how modern GTM systems get built. You'll build the systems and AI that let our GTM teams spend more of their time on customer outcomes.

You'll be on the team that architects and operates the technology the GTM organization runs on: CRM, call intelligence, data enrichment, outbound activation, and the agent orchestration layer that wraps them. You'll partner with data science on the GTM data-to-action loop - designing what we capture, how we translate signals into insight, and how insight becomes a workflow the GTM organization adopts. Your work accelerates and extends our existing push toward AI-native GTM operations.

This is a role for someone who has already rewired their day around AI and pushed others around them to do the same. You'll have real scope to define how GTM Engineering shows up at Watershed: the systems we build, the agents we run, and the patterns we set for how the wider GTM organization adopts AI.

Success means a GTM organization where leadership trusts the systems, the team adopts what we ship, and AI is embedded in how people work day-to-day. This work is measured by adoption and business impact: pipeline velocity, sales efficiency, and customer outcomes.

This role is based in our San Francisco or New York office.

You will:

  • Drive GTM systems end-to-end - Salesforce (data model, integrations, automation), CPQ, lead routing, call intelligence, data enrichment, outbound activation, and scaled support - designing, developing, and shipping what we build, or leading the evaluation and implementation of what we bring on. Partner closely with Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Operations, CS Operations where the work intersects their scope.

  • Build the applied AI layer of the GTM stack: agents and workflows the GTM organization relies on day-to-day, driving pipeline velocity, sales efficiency, and customer outcomes.

  • Build the outbound signal engine with us: signal ingestion, enrichment, play orchestration, and attribution - from the data model to the SDR-facing notification layer - shipping the pilot plays that prove it generates pipeline.

  • Build out the GTM Engineering operating infrastructure: deployment pipeline, branching and sandbox management, testing standards, backups, and the AI dev environment (Claude Code, agents, skills) the team ships in.

  • Partner with data science on the GTM data-to-action loop - driving how we capture data, and how signal becomes insight and insight becomes workflow that moves business outcomes.

  • Bring technical capabilities to the GTM Operations and Marketing Ops teams to accelerate our org's velocity on what we can ship across our systems, our data, and AI tooling.

  • Drive adoption and measurement like a product owner: discover user pain, ship, change-manage, measure trust and business impact across the AI portfolio, and sunset what doesn't earn its place.

  • Build the technical foundation that lets the wider GTM organization work with AI - tools, connections, documentation, supporting agent builds, and operating standards. Partner with Enablement on user-facing training and AI fluency programs.

The ideal candidate brings:

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing or GTM-facing technical role at high-growth B2B SaaS or AI companies, including Revenue Systems, GTM Engineer, or RevOps

  • AI is embedded in the current workflow - deep experience with coding tools (like Cursor or Claude Code), and enterprise agent tooling

  • Broad experience managing the modern GTM tech stack: data enrichment, lead routing, sales engagement, call intelligence, chat, CPQ, support (experience with Salesforce, Gong, Clay, and/or LeanData preferred)

  • Deep technical background in system design and architecture - including data model, integrations, automation, and the tradeoffs between declarative and code-based solutions

  • Experience managing development environments and deployment pipeline (such as Gearset)

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

Watershed is on a mission to drive meaningful climate action, and our Customer Data Services ("CDS") team plays a key role in making that possible. This team acts as data experts to some of the world’s largest and most influential companies, including Walmart, the Carlyle Group, and Stripe. The team helps customers understand Watershed’s data requirements, advises them on data best practices, transforms their data into Watershed’s templates, and documents the steps for traceability. This work gets customers’ data into the platform quickly and accurately, allowing them to spend more time on their sustainability goals.

As a Manager on the Customer Data Services team, you will lead a team of seven Data Specialists in the Mexico City branch of a globally distributed team. In this role, you will enable your team to deliver rigorous, high-quality data services to Watershed’s customers. In addition, you will own strategic initiatives that improve the quality and efficiency of how we deliver, including the integration of AI into the team’s workflows.

This is a unique opportunity to be an early leader within Watershed’s Mexico City office. As a key leader in this office, you will play a critical role in building an inclusive, supportive, and high-performance culture, not only for your team, but for the broader Mexico City office as a whole.

In this role, you will…

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team. You will coach, grow, and hold a high bar for a team of seven Data Specialists, most of them early in their careers.

  • Own what your team produces. You will own the team’s quality and responsiveness metrics, spot-check work, and build the review habits that keep our output error-free.

  • Coach your team on communication and customer-facing skills. You will review the customer communications, documentation, and presentations your team creates, coaching them on structure, tone, and delivery. When coverage is needed, you will step onto a customer call yourself.

  • Drive day-to-day team operations. You will help the team prioritize work, manage capacity and coverage across a growing book of customers, and remove blockers.

  • Support your team when they’re stuck. You will help Data Specialists think through data problems such as how to make a solution scale, where potential quality risks sit, and when to use certain tools. You will direct them to the right resources when the answer lives elsewhere.

  • Own strategic initiatives that raise the bar. Each quarter you will take on workstreams that improve the quality, efficiency, and value of the team’s work.

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

Watershed is seeking an experienced Accounting Manager to own our global general ledger accounting, financial close, and audit preparation as we scale. This role will be responsible for accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and full audit cycle execution. You'll also directly manage and mentor accounting team members as our accounting team grows.

This is a US GAAP-based role supporting our global, consolidated reporting; knowledge of Mexican statutory/monthly reporting requirements or UK GAAP is a plus, not a requirement.

As Accounting Manager, you'll be the engine behind our financial close process and the point person for audit execution and statutory compliance across all Watershed entities and geographies. You'll own complex technical accounting areas including lease accounting, equity transactions, and tax compliance, while building scalable processes and controls to support our ambitious growth trajectory. Working closely with our Technical Accounting team, external auditors, and cross-functional partners, you'll ensure our financial reporting is accurate, timely, and audit-ready.

This is an exceptional opportunity for someone who thrives in high-growth environments, loves building systems and processes from the ground up, and wants to make a meaningful impact on both our business and global climate action.

What You'll Do

GL Management & Financial Close

  • Manage the global general ledger, chart of accounts, and intercompany accounting.

  • Lead and mentor a growing accounting team, providing technical review and coaching, and building a high-performing, inclusive team dynamic that thrives in a fast-paced environment.

  • Drive the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process end-to-end across all Watershed entities and geographies, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.

  • Own a portfolio of accounts through close, reconciliations, and journal entries.

  • Prepare and own US GAAP financial statements, including building the cash flow statements from the ground up.

  • Perform flux analysis, explaining period-over-period movements across the balance sheet and income statement.

  • Own investor and board-level financial reporting.

  • Architect our group-level intercompany framework, elimination logic, transaction-flow documentation, and sources of truth, designed to absorb new entities and future acquisitions.

  • Streamline our intercompany cost-sharing arrangements (pay-on-behalf-of / collect-on-behalf-of) and redesign and automate the cost-allocation process.

Audit, Technical Accounting & Compliance

  • Serve as primary point person for external audits, preparing comprehensive documentation (PBC lists, workpapers, flowcharts, walkthroughs) and coordinating all audit activities, ensuring deliverables are consistently audit-ready with clear supporting evidence.

  • Apply technical US GAAP guidance in key areas including allocations, cashflow, carbon credit accounting, COGS, fixed-assets, FX, lease accounting, and stock-based compensation.

  • Take ownership of tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions and coordinate with external advisors.

  • Manage the accounting and reporting requirements for unique legal entities, including consolidation assessments and entity-level reporting.

Process Innovation, Technology & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Co-own our ERP system with our Finance Systems leads, partnering on configuration, controls, and platform decisions as the accounting function's needs evolve.

  • Act as a tech-forward accounting partner, identifying opportunities to automate tasks through ERP features, AI tools, or emerging technologies, and translating ambiguous business needs into scalable accounting and operational frameworks.

  • Identify bottlenecks in current processes and implement solutions, if something is manual and time-consuming, redesign or automate it.

  • Support ad-hoc projects such as system implementations, new business or entity launches, data quality enhancements, or technical accounting research.

  • Partner with Technical Accounting, FP&A, Legal, People, and Operations teams to support business initiatives and provide accounting guidance across the organization.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience in SaaS or tech companies, with demonstrated experience leading audit preparation and execution. Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus.

  • Deep proficiency in US GAAP with hands-on technical accounting experience including cash flow preparation.

  • Strong experience with financial close and multi-entity/global GL management and accounting.

  • Deep working knowledge of ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, Workday, Rillet), advanced Excel/Google Sheets experience, and a proven track record of using AI tools to eliminate low-value accounting work.

  • Experience building, managing and mentoring high performing, diverse teams that thrive in a fast paced environment.

  • Exceptional ability to work independently, thrive in ambiguity, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate complex accounting positions into plain language for non-accounting partners.

  • Knowledge of Mexican statutory accounting (SAT compliance) and/or UK GAAP is a plus.

  • Fluency in English is required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, plus CPA, CPC (Contador Público Certificado), or an international equivalent preferred.

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

You will shape the strategy, playbooks, systems, and tools that enable our teams to deliver strong customer outcomes efficiently and consistently. This includes developing 1:many engagement programs, improving lifecycle experiences, devising AI first strategies, and partnering with other CS leaders to adapt successful approaches across teams and geographies.

You will work closely with Product, Sales, Sustainability Advisory, Support, and other cross-functional teams to help customers achieve their sustainability goals and translate customer needs into actionable improvements to our products and services

You will help build a diverse, inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team based in San Francisco and across North America.

  • Hire, develop and coach a team of Customer Success Managers

  • Develop and help drive team to achieve key metrics, including customer satisfaction, retention, and expansion

  • Design, build, and oversee strategy and programs for a “Scaled” Customer Success motion. Leverage AI systems and tools to drive personalized scaled experiences and targeted team engagement. Partnering with global CS managers to help them adapt this motion to new geographies.

  • Guide and support your team in delivering customer outcomes at scale, taking an active role in helping them drive 1:many engagement strategies with Watershed’s products and services

  • Partner with your team to act as a key contact with Sr level stakeholders at our customers and support their lifecycle with Watershed

  • Collaborate with our product teams and be the voice of the customer, providing regular and actionable customer feedback

  • Develop and implement processes and tools that help the CS function scale and effectively deliver value for customers

  • Be a representative of the CS function, and of the broader Watershed leadership team, within the San Francisco office

  • A background and experience with Customer Success in an Enterprise SaaS space

  • Experience delivering and managing Scaled Customer Success programs for Mid-Market and Enterprise Customers

  • A passion for people development and coaching

  • Great examples of working cross functionally to build products for customers

  • Experience developing operational processes and delivering on key metrics in early stage/ high growth companies that drive towards operational excellence

We are looking for a customer-focused and analytically-minded person to join the Sustainability Data Advisory team in our Mexico City office on a fixed-term basis, starting in December 2026. You'll work directly with customers as a trusted advisor, leading measurement sessions and delivering advisory services that unlock the full value of our platform. About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

Watershed is on a mission to help companies measure, reduce, remove, and report their emissions. We're looking for a strategic operator to join Customer Operations, which runs the programs that deliver on that mission for hundreds of enterprise customers.

You'll partner closely with Customer leadership to design and build the operational backbone for all three teams in our Customer organization: Customer Success, Sustainability Advisory and Services, and Support. That means the engagement models, scalable systems, forecasting infrastructure, and AI-driven workflows the team runs on, plus the reporting leadership uses to steer the business.

This is a role for a hands-on operator who builds what they design and has already rewired their work around AI. You'll operate as a trusted advisor and force multiplier for Customer leadership, owning initiatives end to end from framing the problem to standing up a working solution the team actually uses. You'll help guide the Ops roadmap rather than working a queue, with real scope to define what modern Customer operations looks like at Watershed.

Success means a Customer organization where structural calls like coverage and staffing are made with evidence rather than instinct, customer health scoring actually changes decisions, teams spend their time on customers instead of manual processes, and AI is embedded in how the team operates day to day.

You'll report to the Head of Customer Operations and join a small team of operators who each support a slice of the Customer organization.

This role is based in our New York or San Francisco office, with an expectation of 4 days per week in office.

You will:

  • Design and implement the Customer operating model. Partner with Customer leadership across Customer Success, Advisory, and Support on:

    • Organizational design, segmentation, and customer engagement models

    • Capacity, staffing, and headcount planning

    • Target setting and performance frameworks

  • Own forecasting from the ground up. Retention, expansion, and services capacity - the methodology, models, and operating cadences that leadership actually trusts, and that surface risk and opportunity early enough to change the outcome

  • Build AI-first operational workflows across the customer lifecycle, along with internal tooling that changes how the team operates day to day

  • Lead strategic initiatives end to end. Drive complex, multi-workstream Customer org initiatives from conception through implementation. You'll frame problems alongside cross-functional partners, and co-build and co-own the result rather than handing over a recommendation

You might be a fit for this role if:

  • You bring 5+ years experience in GTM Operations (CS Ops, RevOps, Strategy & Ops) at a high-growth B2B technology company, or a mix of top-tier strategy consulting and GTM Ops

  • You've supported customer-facing teams directly, especially Customer Success. You know how CSMs actually spend their week, you've owned the reporting and operating cadence behind a retention number, and you can tell a real risk or expansion signal from noise

  • You have demonstrated analytical excellence. You've built the forecasting models behind real leadership decisions, e.g., capacity, retention, expansion

  • You turn ambiguous problems into working systems. You independently take a vague strategic objective through to a plan, a build, and adoption - often as the only person on the problem - and you hold strong opinions about what good looks like

  • You're hands-on with GTM and BI tools like Salesforce, Gong, and Sigma. You build your own systems and partner with GTM Engineering on the bigger lifts. Bonus if you're adept with SQL and Salesforce administration, including automation and data model design

  • AI is already embedded in how you work. You've shipped AI workflows that other teams actually use, and you have a point of view on how Customer teams should evolve because of it

  • You're an exceptional communicator who influences without authority. You can drive alignment across Customer, Product, Data, Sales, and Finance when teams disagree

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We are looking for analytically minded and detail-oriented individuals to join the Customer Data Services team in our New York or San Francisco office on a fixed-term basis starting at the beginning of January 2027. This role is open to early-career candidates with up to 2 years of experience who love working with complex data and want to see how it drives real decisions at the world's largest companies.

 

Watershed is a growth-stage start-up that works with 800+ customers globally, including 100+ of the Fortune 500 and 5 of the top 6 US banks, to accelerate their sustainability programs. You'll work hands-on with customer business data, transforming it to fit Watershed templates and enabling our customers to gain clear, reliable insights into their sustainability impact.


You will

  • Clean and transform customer business data into Watershed templates to reduce customer friction and drive time-to-value.

  • Partner with customers to understand their raw data and recommend best practices for preparing it.

  • Communicate data issues clearly to customers, covering impact, options and trade-offs.

  • Leverage judgment to assess, advise, and execute on data cleaning best practices.

  • Rigorously document decisions to ensure traceability of data manipulations during third-party verifications.

  • Synthesize customer experiences and feedback to drive continuous improvement of our work and inform product development.


You might be a fit if you

  • Have up to 2 years of experience working with large data files in Excel, whether through internships, co-ops or academic projects. Python or SQL is a plus.

  • Thrive on complex, messy data and enjoy the work of making it clean, structured, and trustworthy.

  • Are detail obsessed. You double check your work and do not consider something done until you know it is right.

  • Have good intuition for how numbers in a spreadsheet map to the real world. You translate abstract problems into concrete data frameworks.

  • Have high customer empathy and want to help them achieve their outcomes.

  • Are a strong written and verbal communicator. You can concisely communicate externally to non-technical audiences.

  • Are a low ego team player with a strong sense of ownership. You are driven by team goals and bias for action in order to achieve them.


Fixed-term details

  • Minimum commitment of 4 months, with a possible extension of up to 3 additional months.

  • Fixed-term employees receive compensation and benefits similar to full-time Watershed employees, including daily lunch delivered in the Watershed office.

  • This position requires being in person in our San Francisco or New York office 4 days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

  • Bring strong product judgement and want direct customer contact—not just a list of features to implement.

  • Experience building customer-facing AI products or agentic workflows.

  • A deeply collaborative mindset and a desire to build bridges across Product, Marketing, Sales and Customer teams

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

As an IT Engineer at Watershed, you’ll own the internal technology and SaaS platforms our teams rely on every day and shape how employees experience IT across our global offices. It’s an exciting time to join: we’ve equipped employees with best-in-class AI tools, and you’ll help define what modern IT looks like when AI is woven into how we work. You’ll support employees directly while designing agent-driven workflows, integrations, and self-service resources that reduce toil and turn repetitive tickets into well-engineered systems that make your colleagues’ lives meaningfully better.

As we grow globally, you’ll have real ownership over the systems you build and a direct hand in shaping where IT goes next, partnering closely with teammates in San Francisco and London. We’re looking for someone with deep experience who finds joy in solving problems for people, thrives in a creative, collaborative environment, and has the judgment to balance quick fixes with long-term engineering. If you’re customer-obsessed, hard-working, proactive, inclusive, and optimistic, you’ll fit right in. This position is based in our San Francisco office, where you’ll work four days per week as part of our in-office culture.

You will:

  • Design and implement scalable IT solutions that enhance employee productivity and security across our global offices

  • Manage and maintain our core IT systems, including Okta, Kolide, Iru (formerly Kandji), Google Workspace, Notion, and Slack

  • Develop and optimize our global asset management processes for employee devices throughout their lifecycle

  • Build and maintain reliable automations and integrations across our IT systems, reducing repetitive work in onboarding, access management, device operations, and support

  • Own and improve employee onboarding, role change, and offboarding lifecycle processes through reliable provisioning, access controls, automation, and device workflows in partnership with People and Security

  • Partner with Security, People, Workplace, Engineering, and our external IT support provider to deliver reliable services and a thoughtful employee experience

  • Serve as an escalation point for elevated hardware, software, and network-related issues, as well as occasional in-person support within the San Francisco office

  • Maintain a secure, reliable macOS fleet through device provisioning, configuration, patching, endpoint protection, and compliance monitoring

  • Manage and optimize our conference room technology and A/V systems

  • Turn recurring issues into lasting improvements through root-cause analysis, clear run books, employee-facing guidance, and self-service tools; maintain IT policies and procedures that support consistent service delivery

  • Use AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, system architecture design and workflow development

  • Administer and support our AI platforms, including Claude, ChatGPT, Dust.tt, and Notion AI, managing access, configuration, integrations, and secure adoption across the company

You might be a good fit if:

  • You have 3+ years of increasing experience and responsibility in IT at high-growth technology companies

  • You have hands-on experience administering Okta, including SSO, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows, and understand least-privilege access

  • You have hands-on experience using AI to improve your work, can explain where it has helped, and know when to verify its output or use a different approach

  • You’re comfortable building scripts, using APIs, and workflow automation to solve operational problems, and you test, document, and maintain what you build

  • You have experience managing and supporting Mac-based environments

  • You have experience with asset management systems and lifecycle management for employee devices

  • You're knowledgeable about IT security best practices and compliance requirements

  • You have excellent problem-solving abilities and a track record of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • You're an effective communicator with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • You have experience supporting a breadth of modern SaaS applications

  • You have experience managing vendor relationships and external service providers

  • You're passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and find fulfillment in helping others succeed

Nice to have:

  • First-hand experience building custom tools and applications to solve internal business challenges

  • Experience with zero-trust security frameworks

  • Knowledge of corporate networking fundamentals and troubleshooting

  • Familiarity with office setup and infrastructure planning

  • Direct experience with IT compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO)

  • Industry certifications related to our technology stack (e.g., Okta, Google Workspace, Cisco)

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We’re looking for a Global Head of SDR to lead our Sales Development organization. You will be responsible for managing and developing our inbound and outbound SDR organization and the leaders that are responsible for their performance As a leader in our go-to-market organization, you’ll work directly with our Head of Sales and Marketing to refine our sales playbook, shape Watershed’s product, build a stellar team, and accelerate pipeline generation across the world.

This role is based in our San Francisco headquarters and is co-located with our North American SDR team.

You will:

  • Lead global team to build an integrated account-based outreach strategy, shape a people development program to enable scaled career progression, and create operational rigor for consistent and predictable pipeline forecasting as we continue to scale our pipeline generation engine.

  • Work with Watershed’s Head of Sales and Head of Marketing to implement a sales development plan and strategy to meet/exceed global pipeline generation targets.

  • Drive energy and grow a positive and collaborative culture for today’s SDR teams that inspires teamwork, performance, and professional growth.

  • Align with Sales, GTM Operations, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnership teams on sales strategy, along with high-quality customer experiences between pre and post sales.

  • Oversee day-to-day SDR operations while setting clear expectations and managing performance goals across the global sales development team.

  • Drive an AI-native systems and tooling approach with GTM Operations to empower your teams

  • Accurately report out on the team's performance, KPIs, customer insights, roadblocks and pipeline forecast.

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, with 5+ years of that in enterprise SaaS.

  • Have 5+ years of experience building and managing high performing Sales Development orgs in enterprise SaaS.

  • Have a strong track record of delivering on big quarterly pipeline numbers

  • Have sold products in complex or technical fields, and can share relevant and complex prospecting, account navigation, and pipeline generation experience with a growing team.

  • Have strong collaboration skills, particularly with Marketing and Sales

  • You are great at talent development and management for SDR orgs

  • Have a positive attitude, a love of close team collaboration, and a desire to move and grow quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Have exceptional communication skills with an ability to give and receive feedback thoughtfully.

  • Are excited to lead from one to ten. You love to build things — creating new playbooks for navigating strategic and enterprise organizations and ways to tell the Watershed story.

  • Have a flexible, adaptive, and resilient character with a history of leaving systems, processes, and content better than you found them.

  • Have a love of going deep on new domains. You’re voraciously curious. You’re excited to learn everything about climate and help companies navigate this space.

  • Have extreme ownership of our customers’ first impressions of Watershed. Customers you’ve worked with in the past should rave about working with you.

  • Have experience in high-growth, fast-paced startup environments, preferably with hybrid remote and in-office teams.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. The role

You’ll lead Watershed’s global compensation program. You’ll be our sole dedicated compensation team member, taking ownership of an established, increasingly complex program across the U.S., EMEA, Australia, and Mexico City. This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting to our Head of People: you’ll build and check the models, validate market benchmarks, run compensation planning, and help employees understand their pay. You’ll bring sound judgment to decisions that balance competitiveness, performance, and financial discipline.

Reporting to the Head of People, you’ll partner closely with Finance, People Business Partners, Recruiting, People Operations, and business leaders. You’ll help shape compensation strategy through analysis and recommendations to the Head of People and founders. You’ll independently own execution of our programs including budgeting, planning, education and rollout.

A major focus will be our compensation tools and planning workflows. You’ll help us move away from manual work toward reliable data, well-tested systems, and a better experience for employees as well as the people making and communicating compensation outcomes.

You will

  • Own and evolve compensation planning and tools. Lead the development and continuous improvement of planning tools, models, and workflows to strengthen reliability, usability, and efficiency. Identify opportunities to build new capabilities, reduce manual work, and recommend tools and process improvements that support the company’s evolving compensation needs.

  • Run compensation cycles end to end. Manage timelines, eligibility, cash and equity modeling, budget tracking, approvals, data validation, and final handoffs. Partner with Finance and People Operations to ensure approved decisions are implemented accurately and on time.

  • Lead global benchmarking. Validate market data and job matches, manage survey participation, and maintain compensation ranges across functions and geographies. Bring judgment to imperfect data, document assumptions, and flag where our benchmarks no longer reflect the talent markets we compete in.

  • Build compensation understanding. Help employees understand their compensation and equity, equip managers to communicate decisions, and enable recruiters to explain our programs to candidates. Develop practical guides, FAQs, training, and cycle communications, and help deliver education across time zones.

  • Be the compensation expert for business partners. Advise Recruiting, People Business Partners, and leaders on offers, promotions, role changes, and compensation questions. Make clear, data-backed recommendations and explain the trade-offs.

  • Keep data and processes dependable. Maintain accurate compensation records, documented decision rules, and appropriate checks and access controls. Improve reporting and reduce recurring manual work using approved automation and AI, with careful protection of employee information and verification of outputs.

  • Execute executive compensation programs. Prepare analyses and models, coordinate approvals, and carry approved executive compensation decisions through implementation in partnership with the Head of People, founders, Finance, and Legal.

  • Coordinate across global and functional partners. Work with Finance, Legal, People Operations, and Revenue Operations on local requirements, compensation data, and implementation. Benefits and sales incentive design are owned elsewhere.

You have

  • 7+ years of experience in compensation, or equivalent depth of expertise, including hands-on ownership of compensation programs and cycles.

  • Experience managing compensation programs at technology companies, including SaaS businesses, with an understanding of how cash and equity support hiring, performance, and retention.

  • Strong compensation fundamentals: market pricing, survey participation, job matching, salary ranges, cash and equity compensation, and budget modeling.

  • Experience implementing or materially improving compensation planning tools, including configuration, testing, rollout, and adoption. You can translate compensation rules into workflows.

  • Advanced spreadsheet skills. You can build and audit complex models.

  • Hands-on experience with U.S. compensation practices and experience supporting compensation in at least one other country. You can learn unfamiliar local requirements and work effectively with regional experts. Experience in Mexico a strong plus!

  • The ability to turn complex compensation concepts into clear employee education, manager guidance, and leadership recommendations.

  • Practical fluency with AI tools and prompt engineering and a willingness to use them to improve analysis, documentation, and recurring workflows. You know how to validate outputs and protect sensitive compensation data.

  • Strong project management, attention to detail, and discretion. You can prioritize independently, follow through, and deliver work that people trust.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a genuine interest in being a hands-on, sole compensation specialist with strong cross-functional partners.

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We’re looking for a customer-focused problem solver to join our Implementation team. You’ll lead end-to-end deployments of Watershed for our largest and most complex strategic accounts - translating goals into clear plans, finding solutions to customer needs, orchestrating cross-functional work, and building customer confidence.

You’ll design scalable systems and processes for repeatability while also solving complex, bespoke needs for our largest customers. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, advisory, customer success, and external partners to keep momentum high and outcomes measurable. This is a unique opportunity to play a critical role driving the success of Watershed’s customer base.

 

You will:

  • Own and deliver implementations from kickoff to wrap-up: run discovery, map milestones, manage risks, and drive crisp execution

  • Serve as the customer’s primary point of contact during implementations, building high‑trust relationships across technical and non‑technical stakeholders

  • Design out-of-the-box, creative solutions that meet customer needs, leveraging existing product and services and generating insight into potential future needs

  • Develop a deep understanding of Watershed’s product and services to guide customers on what’s possible and make smart trade‑offs

  • Conduct enablements for customers on using complex Watershed features

  • Coordinate internal and customer teams, sequence dependencies, and renegotiate timelines when inputs change

  • Act as the voice of the customer to product and engineering, surfacing patterns, blockers, and feature requests that inform the roadmap

  • Build scalable playbooks, tooling, and processes that make implementations faster, more consistent, and measurable over time

 

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 3-6+ years in management consulting, solutions, or software implementation, preferably at a B2B SaaS company. You have experience leading customers through complex programs or projects

  • Take pride in your ability to learn new concepts quickly and thrive operating in a high-volume environment

  • Love to sweat the details, but are also able to zoom-out and see the big picture

  • Are a systems thinker who brings structure, clarity, and momentum to ambiguous problems

  • Are excellent at communicating clearly with technical and non‑technical audiences to introduce new concepts and drive alignment

  • Love working on multiple workstreams simultaneously, juggling multiple balls and keeping stakeholders accountable

  • Have a keen eye for identifying risks and drive mitigation plans to keep projects on track

  • Are an early adopter of AI solutions and excited to use them to drive impact

 

This position is required to be in person in our London office 4 days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

As our first dedicated payroll leader, you'll own payroll at Watershed end to end and build the controls, processes, and automation that let us grow headcount and geographies without growing manual work. You'll run payroll for our US and UK entities and oversee in-country payroll in Mexico and through our EOR partners.

This role is hands-on. You’ll run our day-to-day payroll operations while building the processes and automation that let the function scale as we expand. You'll partner closely with People Ops, Accounting, Legal, and Revenue Operations, and you'll be the go-to person for payroll questions across the company.

You will leverage AI and automation to streamline payroll workflows, applying strong judgment to determine where human oversight remains critical.

You will:

  • Build the global payroll function: the documentation, processes, calendars, checklists, SOPs, and controls that let payroll scale with headcount, hire and develop a team as we grow, and lead the payroll side of expanding into new geographies.

  • Own end-to-end global payroll, including new hires, terminations, salary changes, bonuses, commissions, and leave pay, and act as the escalation point for complex payroll issues and employee pay questions.

  • Manage our in-country payroll providers and EOR partners across multiple countries, validating inputs and outputs, evaluate the right long-term model for each country, and evaluate payroll tools and providers, recommending what to adopt based on accuracy, cost, and risk.

  • Own payroll configuration in Rippling and keep payroll data flowing cleanly to the general ledger as we scale, using AI and workflow automation to remove manual work.

  • Administer deductions and retirement contributions, including 401(k) remittances, and reconcile plan contributions to the plan administrator.

  • Maintain compliance with payroll taxes, wages, and statutory requirements across the US and the UK, including registrations, filings, year-end reporting, and responses to tax authority notices, and support financial statements, statutory, and 401(k) plan audits with documentation and responses to auditors.

  • Administer sales commissions and other variable pay with Revenue Operations so plans are paid accurately and on schedule.

  • Support equity-related payroll processes, including withholding and reporting on exercises and vesting events, in coordination with Legal and Carta.

  • Partner with Accounting on payroll journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end close, with the goal of bringing payroll accounting into the payroll function over time, and with People Ops on employee lifecycle events (hires, terminations, leaves, and compensation changes) so the data flowing into payroll is accurate.

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 7+ years in payroll, or in finance or accounting with substantial global payroll ownership

  • Have hands-on US & UK payroll experience. Experience with Mexico, Australia or Germany payroll is a strong plus.

  • Have experience working with an EOR or PEO to cover countries without a local entity.

  • Have hands-on experience with Rippling, including payroll-to-GL integrations.

  • Enjoy partnering closely with HR, Accounting, Revenue Operations, and external providers to keep payroll accurate and on time.

  • Are familiar with commission and variable pay structures, and with equity compensation payroll mechanics (withholding and reporting on option exercises and RSU vesting).

  • Feel comfortable with journal entries, accruals, and reconciliations, and with closing out your own work.

  • Are detail-oriented, with strong Excel, data, and report-building skills, and practical experience using AI tools to reduce manual effort.

  • Are excited to build structure and controls where none exist yet, and comfortable working hands-on while leading others.

  • Are able to explain payroll clearly to non-experts across time zones, with sound judgment on confidentiality and when to escalate.

  • Hold a Certified Payroll Professional (CPP), Chartered Institute of Payroll Professionals (CIPP) or an equivalent certification.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.
